# Metric v1

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's metric/v1 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.MetricV1(ctx)` (openstacksdk: No directly corresponding service (Aetos)).

This version implements the Aetos Prometheus API, not the same functionality as Python openstacksdk's Gnocchi metric service.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.MetricV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
data, err := service.Metrics.Query(ctx, metrics.QueryOpts{Query: "up"})
if err != nil { return err }
fmt.Println(data)
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.

`metrics` refers to `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/metric/v1/metrics`.
